text: S A P and Oracle E Business Suite run the business.
But years of inactive data keep bloating databases, slowing performance, and driving up costs, right when you're planning a move to S four HANA, or the cloud.
Solix Cloud brings more than twenty years of ERP archiving expertise, to both.
For S A P, Solix Cloud works natively through SAP's Archive Development Kit, with pre-built support for standard archive objects across Finance, Materials, Sales, and more.
For Oracle E Business Suite, Solix is certified by Oracle, and covers both archiving and full application retirement.
Inactive data moves out on policy, and stays searchable, reportable, and under legal hold, for as long as you need it.
Leaner production systems, cleaner migrations, and S A P databases, up to thirty to sixty percent smaller.
Your ERP history becomes AI-ready data, not dead weight.
Solix Cloud. Built for S A P. Built for Oracle.
